latestVersion.changelog:
Free Video Cutter Online — Initial Release

- Launches the first version of the Free Video Cutter Online skill.
- Lets users trim, cut, and export video clips to 1080p MP4, WebM, or GIF formats via cloud GPU processing.
- Supports upload and editing of MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files; handles export jobs within 20-40 seconds.
- Automates session management and authentication with free token provisioning (100 credits, 7-day validity).
- Provides a simple prompt-based interface for video trimming, export, credits check, and status updates.
- All exports and heavy processing are handled on the backend—no local CPU/GPU required.
